name: and

phase_0.boundary_condition: the truth table of logical AND: only (true, true) yields true; all others yield false.

VINIT.justification: initial state before any truth value is assigned.

TANCH.justification: the complete set of truth assignments that defines AND.

AFWD.justification: forward application of AND to two truth values.

AREV.justification: reverse lookup: given a result, find possible input pairs.

CLINK.justification: composition of multiple AND gates in sequence.

IMSCRIB.justification: self-identity: AND with identical inputs returns the input.

FSPLIT.justification: splits a truth value into two identical copies for later conjunction.

FFUSE.justification: AND of two identical truth values recovers the original.

ENGAGR.justification: a state where true and false are simultaneously asserted, e.g., liar paradox.

IFIX.justification: permanent record of the AND truth table, immutable.

phase_2.split_input: a truth value x (either true or false)

phase_3.void_description: no truth values have been assigned yet
phase_3.true_description: the truth value true is asserted
phase_3.false_description: the truth value false is asserted
phase_3.both_description: a paradoxical state where both true and false are held

steps.domain_action: initial void state, no truth values exist
self-reference that we are working with truth values
forward evaluation begins, inputs p and q are introduced
split on p's truth value into T-arm (if p true) and F-arm (if p false)
p is true (T-arm entry)
within T-arm, split on q's truth value into T-arm (q true) and F-arm (q false)
q is true (inner T-arm)
AND result is true
(inner T-arm routes to inner FFUSE T input)
q is false (inner F-arm)
AND result is false
(inner F-arm routes to inner FFUSE F input)
combine inner split on q back to single result (true or false)
(result routes to outer FFUSE T input)
p is false (F-arm entry)
AND result is false directly (false AND anything = false)
(F-arm routes to outer FFUSE F input)
combine outer split on p to final AND result
store the outcome as a record in the truth table
close the system with the complete truth table

phase_5.compiler_frontend: translates logical expressions into evaluation operations
phase_5.memory_mechanism: stores truth assignments and evaluation results
phase_5.alfs_store: the canonical truth table of logical AND

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — deterministic operation conserves information; no loss
